name: Skill Quality Gate
description: Validates OpenClaw skill files have required frontmatter, API calls, and response formats before they can be synced

then.prompt:
If the file being written is an OpenClaw skill file (matches *-skill.md in the openclaw directory), validate it has:
1. Valid YAML frontmatter with name, description, and metadata fields
2. At least one exec() or web_search() call pattern
3. A response format section showing how to present results
4. Ethical boundaries or deflection rules

If any are missing, warn about it but allow the write. If the file is NOT a skill file, ignore this check entirely and allow the operation.
